articles.title: CW Bancorp (CWBK) Stock Price Slips After Q3 Earnings Improve Margins
articles.summary: CW Bancorp came into this Q3 2026 earnings report looking like a classic value bank, trading on a P/E of 8.9x and down roughly 3% over the past month. The stock slipped another 0.9% to about $40.65 after the release, yet the headline result was quietly solid. Basic earnings per share landed at $1.12 with net income of $3.287m, and trailing net profit margin over the past year has improved to 28% from 26.8%. The gap between a soft share price and firmer profitability is now the key story...
